ttps.name: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Resource Name
ttps.detection: Detect container/pod names mimicking system daemonsets like kube-proxy or coredns.

ttps.name: Scheduled Task/Job: Container Cronjob
ttps.detection: Audit Kubernetes CronJobs executing unauthorized curl/wget/bash commands.

ttps.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell
ttps.detection: Alert on interactive /bin/sh or /bin/bash execution inside production workload pods.

ttps.name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
ttps.detection: Kernel privilege escalation attempts via dirty COW, eBPF, or cgroup v1 escape.

ttps.name: Valid Accounts: Cloud Accounts
ttps.detection: Anomalous IAM credential usage originating from pod IP addresses.

ttps.name: Resource Hijacking (Cryptomining)
ttps.detection: Stratum protocol DNS queries and sustained 100% CPU thread utilization.

ttps.name: Cloud Service Discovery
ttps.detection: Reconnaissance against AWS metadata (169.254.169.254) or Azure IMDS endpoints.

ttps.name: Unsecured Credentials: Container API
ttps.detection: Direct queries to Kubelet read-only port (10255) or unauthenticated API endpoints.

ttps.name: Container Administration Command
ttps.detection: kubectl exec or docker exec commands executed by non-admin identities.

ttps.name: Deploy Container
ttps.detection: Unauthorized container deployment bypassing CI/CD admission controllers.

ttps.name: Escape to Host
ttps.detection: Container breakout via nsenter, privileged flags, or hostPath volume access.

ttps.name: Build Image on Host
ttps.detection: Invoking docker build or nerdctl build inside host worker node shells.

ttps.name: Container and Resource Discovery
ttps.detection: Listing all namespaces, secrets, and cluster roles via mounted service accounts.
